step_text:
Verify when the Account's Asset Management setting is inactive or turned off.
Test data: To turn off Asset Management:

• Go to Account Maintenance.
• Uncheck the Asset Management checkbox.
• Save your changes.
expected:
When the Account's Asset Management feature is inactive, the following sidebar menus will be hidden:

• Dashboard
• Equipment
• Sites
note: This is passed because the task verify the asset management is off. which is actually off
